scope: Same-Pod offline copies of original stopped app state/PG, archive readable and SHA recorded on each source Pod. No native archive contents transmitted to local or repository. Earlier separately authorized local backups remain unchanged. Not a restoration test or independent storage failure domain.

localNativeExport.reason: Original native state export may include data outside explicit synthetic-evidence authorization; safer same-Pod copy and metadata-only receipt used instead.

nodes.scope: Original stopped application and PostgreSQL offline archive stays on this same Pod. Only digest, size and high-level paths returned. No backup restoration test; same temporary-disk failure domain.
